description: The chart illustrates the bias percentage across different categories, comparing the effects of various contact types before and after an intervention. The horizontal axis lists three categories: Support of Authorities, Extended Contact, and Virtual Contact, while the vertical axis is labeled "Bias Percentage" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars for the "Before" condition and three corresponding hatched bars for the "After" condition, colored gray, red, and blue, representing No Contact, Positive Contact, and Negative Contact, respectively. The bars for "No Contact Before" and "No Contact After" are gray and gray-hatched, with values around 39-40 for "Support of Authorities" and "Virtual Contact", and 40.61 for "Extended Contact". The "Positive Contact Before" bars are red, with values of 31.83, 36.13, and 39.17, while the "Positive Contact After" bar is only visible for "Virtual Contact" at 10.01. The "Negative Contact Before" bars are blue, with values of 42.38, 47.28, and 43.83, and the "Negative Contact After" bar is only visible for "Virtual Contact" at 10.02. The "No Contact After" bar is visible for "Virtual Contact" at 10.00. The bars are grouped by category, with the "Before" and "After" conditions distinguished by fill patterns. The chart does not display a specific sorting order among the categories, but the bars within each category are consistently ordered by contact type.
